description: This file is a Java interface that defines data access methods for ShoppingCart entities, including retrieval by ID, customer, code, and removal.

classes.name: ShoppingCartDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for shopping cart persistence operations, extending generic entity DAO with specific methods for shopping cart retrieval and removal.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart associated with a specific Customer.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getShoppingCartById
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its ID without collection objects.

methods.name: getShoppingCartByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart by its code without collection objects.
